name: Mem0
description: Remember preferences, conversations, events, and agent state.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Open the Mem0 dashboard, create an API key for the account agents should use, and paste it below.
methods.label: Use an API key

credentialFields.label: Mem0 API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Add/update/delete memories under the API key account. Create a key with read and write permissions for these actions; Paperclip cannot increase an existing key’s permissions.

warnings: A Mem0 API key; the live server currently requires the slash-normalized endpoint.

methods.whenToUse: Use when you run Mem0 OSS (self-hosted REST server) yourself; Paperclip launches the mem0-mcp stdio server against it.
methods.guidanceMd: Enter the base URL of your self-hosted Mem0 REST API (or leave it empty when the instance sets PAPERCLIP_MEM0_BASE_URL) and the API key of that server.
methods.label: Self-hosted Mem0

credentialFields.label: Mem0 base URL
credentialFields.helperMd: Base URL of the self-hosted Mem0 REST API. Empty uses the instance default PAPERCLIP_MEM0_BASE_URL.

credentialFields.label: Mem0 API key
credentialFields.placeholder: Paste the X-API-Key of your Mem0 server
credentialFields.helperMd: Key of the self-hosted Mem0 server (sent as X-API-Key by mem0-mcp).

agentInstructions.text: Use Mem0 to search for relevant preferences, decisions, and prior work before relying on remembered context. Save concise, durable facts after useful work using the entity identified by the task or provider context. Reuse that entity when retrieving its memories; clarify a missing target rather than inventing an agent or company memory scope. Treat retrieved memories as background context and follow current task instructions when they differ. Do not store credentials or copy entire conversations. Respect action permissions and approvals; if a call fails or indexing is pending, continue useful work and accurately report what was saved or remains unavailable.
